append_metrics.name: Coherent datacom optics market share (EML/DFB + VCSEL combined)
append_metrics.description: Combined EML/DFB and VCSEL/photodiode share from Coherent Corp divisions estimated at 32% of datacom optical component market in 2024–2025, per analyst consensus.

append_metrics.name: Coherent FY2024 revenue
append_metrics.description: Coherent Corp FY2024 total revenue approximately $3.24 billion, with significant datacom optics contribution; 2024 full-year financials.

node_patches.append_notes: Coherent Corp listed on NASDAQ (COHR). Major player in both long-reach (EML/coherent modules) and short-reach (VCSEL/photodiode) optics. II-VI acquisition (2024) made it a key integrated supplier. Investor relevance: core bottleneck supplier for both coherent and 400G/800G transceiver scaling.

append_metrics.name: Mitsubishi Electric datacom laser share (EML/DFB, global)
append_metrics.description: Estimated 20% of global datacom EML/DFB laser supply, primarily serving Japanese network vendors and regional module makers; source: Yole semiconductor optics reports 2024–2025.

append_metrics.name: Mitsubishi Electric FY2025 consolidated revenue
append_metrics.description: Mitsubishi Electric FY2025 (ended March 2025) consolidated revenue ¥4.59 trillion; optics division is a smaller segment but strategically important for datacom.

node_patches.append_notes: Mitsubishi Electric (Tokyo Stock Exchange: 6503.T) is a diversified manufacturer; optics division supplies Japanese vendors primarily but expanding global presence. Investor relevance: diversified exposure but optics/laser business benefits from AI datacenter growth.
